description: Set soft_write_failure = true in puppetdb.conf so the server compiles catalogs while OpenVoxDB is unreachable, keeping a copy of the file; or put the copy back. For the agent run that brings OpenVoxDB back on a rebuilt host

mode.description: enable_if_unreachable (default: only when the first server_url does not answer), enable, or restore (put the kept copy back)
